aria: Animated recap of the Lakers' 138 to 117 home win over Miami: Luka Dončić's three for his 40th point, quarter-by-quarter scoring, his 42 points and 13 assists, the top scorers, how the Lakers won, and the next game at Sacramento.
notes: Box score from the Lakers' 138–117 home win over the Miami Heat on Nov 2, 2026, from the league's official stats feed, with game details from the AP (via NBC Miami), Reuters (via Deadspin) and the Miami Herald (via Yahoo Sports). The five scorers shown account for 106 of the 138 points; the rest came from the bench. The Kings' record and the Lakers' conference standing are from the same feed. The playoff odds are from the Box & Motion model (preseason win totals plus results, 60,000 simulations).

The play of the game is an original illustration of Luka Dončić's three that gave him 40 points and put the Lakers up 128–106 with 5:37 left, as reported by Reuters. The recaps don't describe how he got the shot, so it is drawn as a plain pull-up. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page: 808 bass, claps, rolling hi-hats and a short plucked riff. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Los Angeles Lakers or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.
